question: A solid brass sphere has a diameter of 10.5 cm. Find the cost of tin-plating its surface at a rate of ₹4 per 100 cm². Use π = 22/7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diameter = 10.5 cm ⇒ Radius = 5.25 cm

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

= 4 × (22/7) × (5.25)² = 346.5 cm²

Cost = 346.5 × (4 ÷ 100) = 13.86

**∴ Answer = ₹13.86**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter = 10.5 cm, Rate = ₹4 per 100 cm², π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

 
• 10.5 cm O 

Radius = 10.5 ÷ 2 = 5.25 cm

Use formula to find curved surface area

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × (5.25)²

⇒ = 4 × (22/7) × 27.5625

⇒ = 346.5 cm²

⇒ Cost = 346.5 × (4 ÷ 100)

⇒ = 13.86

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13.86.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

Formula: 4 × π × r²

Unit Conversion in Cost

Always adjust rate properly: ₹4 per 100 cm² ⇒ multiply by (area ÷ 100).

Diameter vs Radius

Radius = Diameter ÷ 2, must convert before applying formula.
